name: SET_CARDINALITY_AND_WARNING_REMOVAL
description: Replaces the algebraic difference constraint with an explicit enumeration of valid unordered voltage sets ({1,2}, {1,3}, {2,3}) to prevent immediate recognition of the inequality operator. Additionally, removes the explicit warning about simple backtracking and degree-counting, which previously served as a strong hint for the models to implement MRV/DSATUR heuristics.
